remarks: Welcome to 21 Rolling Wood Drive in the convenient and sought-after Pepper Ridge neighborhood. Large vaulted ceiling in both living room with gas fireplace and dining room featuring hardwood floors, custom built-ins and large picture windows. Custom hood over the gas stove, convection/microwave, granite counters, greenhouse window over the kitchen sink, and recessed lights are just some on the features in this cheerful eat-in kitchen with sliders to large custom deck.  Enjoy countless days and nights entertaining or lounging on the large deck, with covered area for dining overlooking saltwater pool and bar area. Family room features custom built-in's and gas stove, and den/office, laundry area and powder bath complete the first floor. 3 bedrooms, primary with 2 walk-in closets and full bath complete the third level. Full unfinished walk-out basement. Convenient to Merritt Parkway, I-95, bus line, neighborhood schools, shopping, library, restaurants, Metro North, downtown Stamford with UCONN branch and Houses of Worship. Stamford is indeed one of the top 50 best places in the US to live and raise a family with it's public beaches, parks, 2 public golf courses, recreational facilities, and entertainment venues.
